site.name: SHIN-YU-MIN
site.tagline: Yuchi, Sun Moon Lake · Family Tea Makers
site.description: A family tea factory in Dayan Village, Yuchi Township, Nantou — the heart of the Sun Moon Lake black tea region. Best known for Ruby Black Tea (Taiwan Tea No. 18).

home.heroBody: Dayan Village, Yuchi Township, Nantou — the heart of the Sun Moon Lake black tea region. This is not a sourcing choice; it is where our family has lived and made tea for generations.
home.originTitle: From leaf to tin, all under our own roof
home.originBody: Plucking, withering, rolling, oxidation, drying — every step happens in our own factory in Dayan Village, tended by hand. We do not make many teas, but each one is made properly.
